transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we lock the program, I need to hear from rights clearance and submissions staff — are there any outstanding issues with any of the competition titles, including 'After the Floodlights'? If everything is clear, we'll finalize the listing with the public screening and online trailer as currently drafted.

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue with 'After the Floodlights.' I reviewed the executed music and archive license this morning, and the terms are restrictive: the festival may hold exactly one in-person public screening, may not publish any trailer or excerpt online, and we must use the exact credit 'Courtesy of Northline Archive.' I hadn't added the license summary to the programming file yet because the signed copy arrived in my separate clearance inbox, but the constraints are confirmed.

transcript.text: I need to flag a premiere-status issue with 'After the Floodlights.' This means it fails the competition's unpublished-premiere requirement. If we retain it, it must be offered as a single special screening rather than as a competition title. I haven't updated the submission record yet because the database correction queue is still open, but the issue is confirmed.
